id: \bWhen the player goes outside, be sure to transfer the player onto the door rather than next to it. It looks better that way.
en: \bWhen the player goes outside, be sure to transfer the player onto the door rather than next to it.  It looks better that way.
it: \bQuando il giocatore esce, assicurati di trasferirlo sopra la porta e non accanto. Così è più bello da vedere.
